title: Sum of Mutated Array Closest to Target
goal: Choose an integer cap making the capped sum closest to the target, preferring the smaller cap on ties.
strategy: Capped sums are monotone. Find the first cap whose sum reaches the target, then compare it with its predecessor to handle undershoot and overshoot.
